name: gap-log-provenance-chain-reanchor
title: Restore gap_log by re-anchoring the B-META provenance chain across the identity cutover and re-clone
description: gap_log has been unusable on main since B-cc10 flipped GAP_LOG_ARTIFACT_PATH to .proof-or-stop/ (commit 8c0bd7b87c, 2026-08-17): every call fails with 'existing provenance chain is not extendable (invalid_binding_shape)'. Two independent breaks must be handled by one explicit migration design: (1) all 32 legacy receipts carry '.lattice/' artifactPath/ledgerPath literals inside the signed payload and the verifier resolves receipt 1's genesis anchor at the new path, so the chain fails before any HMAC check; (2) the HMAC key lived in .git/ and was lost when the repository was re-cloned on 2026-08-30, so the legacy HMACs can never be re-verified. The artifact content itself is intact (current findings.json digest equals receipt 32 postArtifactDigest). B-49df did not fix this; its runtime probe only recorded the failure.
